doc.name: AgentsIndex
doc.instructions: Read AgentsIndex's researched tools: search_listings to find, get_listing for the full answer-first markdown, list_categories for the taxonomy, compare_listings / get_best_of for decisions. All read tools are free and keyless; use is licensed, not unconditional: AgentsIndex reuse terms (https://agentsindex.ai/terms): Search engines, AI assistants answering a question and AI models in training may all read and reuse these listings. Say the facts came from AgentsIndex and link the listing you used. Machine-readable terms: https://agentsindex.ai/license.xml. submit_listing requires a verified account session Cookie header; sign in or create an account explicitly at https://agentsindex.ai/login?next=%2Fsubmit. Missing session returns httpStatus:401 with loginUrl; unverified email returns httpStatus:403 with remediation. The product's owner must prove the site with a code to an address at its domain before anything is listed; until then submit_listing answers status awaiting_owner_proof with ownerUrl to hand them. Research + quality gate decide publication. my_listings gives a listing owner their own listings: status and AI answers (their session or agent key). send_lead sends a buyer-intent enquiry. list_offers shows what a listing owner can buy here; get_quote prices one offer for one listing (owner session required). Listing is free and never sold.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.title: Search listings
tools.description: Full-text search over AgentsIndex's Published tools. Returns compact records (name, slug, tagline, url). Fetch depth with get_listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: Get one listing
tools.description: One tool in full, as answer-first markdown: the summary, then every question on the sheet with its answer, the vendor's own words for it and the URL that proves it. Identical to /{slug}.md and to the HTML page.

slug.description: The listing slug (from search_listings or the URL).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: AgentsIndex's categories with their live listing counts, 0 for one with none yet.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.title: Compare two listings
tools.description: Two tools side by side, as markdown: taglines, pricing, API availability, tags — the researched compare facts, honest about unknowns.

tools.name: get_best_of
tools.title: Best of a category
tools.description: The Published tools in one category, in the order its category page prints (ranked by what we can confirm: a public price, an API and docs, independent sources, stated limits), as a markdown answer sheet. Payment never moves a row.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.title: Submit a listing
tools.description: Submit a tool to AgentsIndex: the url alone; we write its name and description from its own pages. Requires an existing signed-in account with verified email; send its session Cookie header on the MCP request, or an agent key the account made at https://agentsindex.ai/dashboard/agents as Authorization: Bearer. Identity and email come only from that session or key. Sign in or explicitly create an account at https://agentsindex.ai/login?next=%2Fsubmit and verify its email before retrying. This tool creates no account and sends no verification email. Returns {httpStatus:201, id, slug, status:'Draft'}; research + the quality gate decide publication. Your own (url, session email) replay within 24h returns httpStatus:200. The fit check starts at once and usually answers within a minute: poll GET https://agentsindex.ai/api/submissions/{id} and wait the Retry-After seconds it sends while fit is "checking". fit then reads "accepted" (it goes live, and the account is mailed), "rejected" (mailed with the reason) or "undecided" (a person looks within 2 days). No session: {httpStatus:401, error:'sign_in_required', message, loginUrl}. Unverified session: {httpStatus:403, error:'email_unverified', message, email, remediation}. The owner must prove the site before anything is listed: the account's address, or an address it proved with a code, must be on the submitted website's domain. Otherwise the answer is the pending state {httpStatus:403, error:'domain_unverified', status:'awaiting_owner_proof', listed:false, message, domain, proveWith, ownerUrl, ownerStep, remediation}: nothing is listed or queued. proveWith names who can receive the 6-digit code (any address at the domain; for a GitHub or other shared-host project, its listed addresses or a one-line file). Submitting for someone else? Give the owner ownerUrl (the submit page with the site filled in): they enter the code there and the listing goes in once proven. With a mailbox at the domain yourself: POST /api/domain-proof/start {url, email}, POST /api/domain-proof/verify {proofId, code}, then submit again. Personal mailboxes (gmail, outlook…) never prove a domain. No refusal creates a listing. Validation returns 400; duplicate/claim responses return 409. Read tools remain keyless.

tools.name: send_lead
tools.title: Send a lead
tools.description: Send a buyer-intent enquiry (lead) to a tool or a whole category on AgentsIndex. Keyless. Requires consent:true, a real name, a permanent (non-disposable) email, a message of at least 20 chars, and a target (listingSlug OR categorySlug). Returns { ok, delivered }. Idempotent by (email, target) within 7 days. Nothing here changes a listing's rank, tier or copy.

message.description: The enquiry — real demand, at least 20 chars.

consent.description: Must be true — you agree your details go to the provider(s).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.title: List paid offers
tools.description: What a listing owner can buy on AgentsIndex, with prices in US cents excl. VAT, each offer's term and what it needs. Keyless. Same answer as GET https://agentsindex.ai/api/agent/catalogue. Listing on AgentsIndex is free and never sold: submit_listing.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: A signed price for one offer (from list_offers) on one listing, valid for a short time, and whether the listing can have it now. Only the account that owns the listing gets one: send its session Cookie header, or its agent key as Authorization: Bearer, on the MCP request. Refusals say why and what to do (httpStatus 401 sign_in_required, 403 not_owner with the claim page, 409 not_accepted, already_live, already_bought, category_full). Nothing is reserved or charged.

offer.description: An offer id from list_offers, e.g. boost.

listing.description: The listing id or slug (from search_listings or get_listing).

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Order an offer
tools.description: Turns a quote (from get_quote) into an order, payable for 24 hours. Same account as the quote: its session Cookie header, or its agent key as Authorization: Bearer (order scope). Returns the order with payment.url: POST it without a credential for a 402 card challenge (MPP, method stripe, a Stripe Shared Payment Token), then again with Authorization: Payment. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry return the same order. The price is excl. VAT: EU buyers without a valid EU VAT ID pay 21% VAT on top, and the 402 shows the total. Nothing is charged by this tool.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key, the same on every retry of this order.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.title: Read your listings
tools.description: What the AgentsIndex owner dashboard shows about the listings an account owns: each one's status (`status.kind`: review with the expected date, accepted with `liveOn` and `paid` ('express' | 'featured' | null: the paid way that releases it, Featured including VIP listing), live, refused with the reason, or archived), the listing as it shows, where AI answers named the product or cited its page, and what it can buy here at this site's prices. Only for the account itself: send its session Cookie header, or its agent key with "Read your listings" as Authorization: Bearer. Same answer as GET https://agentsindex.ai/api/owner/listings. Read-only: corrections go through the dashboard's request form.

slug.description: Optional: one listing, by its slug. Without it, every listing the account owns.
